description: Slide-in side panel (left or right) with overlay backdrop, header/body/footer slots, and configurable close behavior via Escape key and overlay click.

parameters.name: IsOpen
parameters.description: Whether the drawer is open.

parameters.name: IsOpenChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the drawer should open or close.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Side from which the drawer slides in. Bottom renders the drawer as a sheet.

parameters.name: ShowHandle
parameters.description: Whether a bottom sheet shows its drag handle. The gesture follows the panel itself when the handle is hidden.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width of the drawer panel.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Title shown in the header.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: An accessible name for the drawer when neither Title nor HeaderContent names it (a header rendered through HeaderContent carries no automatic label). Emitted as aria-label on the focus-scope root (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: ShowOverlay
parameters.description: Show a semi-transparent backdrop behind the drawer.

parameters.name: CloseOnOverlayClick
parameters.description: Close the drawer when clicking the overlay.

parameters.name: CloseOnEscape
parameters.description: Close the drawer when pressing Escape.

parameters.name: ShowCloseButton
parameters.description: Show the X close button in the header.

parameters.name: HeaderContent
parameters.description: Custom header content (replaces Title).

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Main body content.

parameters.name: FooterContent
parameters.description: Optional footer with action buttons.

parameters.name: Modal
parameters.description: Whether the drawer is modal. A non-modal drawer renders inside its container with no overlay and no inert background.

parameters.name: SnapPoints
parameters.description: Fractions of the viewport height a bottom sheet snaps to. Null or empty is content height under the max-height cap.

parameters.name: SnapIndex
parameters.description: The snap the sheet renders. Two-way with SnapIndexChanged.

parameters.name: SnapIndexChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the rendered snap changes.

parameters.name: MaxHeight
parameters.description: The sheet cap as a fraction of the visible viewport, between 0 and 1.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTarget
parameters.description: The element focus returns to when the drawer closes.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTargetId
parameters.description: The id of the restore target.

parameters.name: InitialFocusSelector
parameters.description: A CSS selector resolved inside the scope for the element that receives focus when the drawer opens (e.g. the first menuitem of a menu sheet). Null keeps the default first focusable (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: SwipeToDismiss
parameters.description: Whether a downward swipe past the lowest snap dismisses the sheet.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the sheet renders. Auto follows the viewport scope; a forced value renders that mode without a DOM.

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the first measurement.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the rendered layout changes. The initial value is not a change.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.
